source_event.finding: A-004 stale handoff after material remediation

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery certificate can remain internally valid yet stop representing the delivered candidate when material implementation changes land after certification.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a previously green certificate as reusable after code, migration, tests, documentation, or other material candidate files change.
trigger_signals: certificate identity differs from frozen candidate
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Freeze the material candidate, regenerate all readiness artifacts for that identity, then permit only hash-bound result files in a narrowly allowlisted child commit.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Certification must be the final operation after material implementation is frozen; any later material mutation invalidates readiness and requires regeneration.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Before audit handoff, compare certificate identity with the frozen material candidate and reject any descendant containing paths outside the result-only allowlist.

transfer_cases.evidence: synthetic contract: a migration added after certification forces a new material candidate and certificate
synthetic contract: material test/docs changes after certification invalidate the prior handoff rather than inheriting it

skill_changes.evidence: entregar-issue handoff contract requires frozen candidate identity and result-only child policy
focused entregar-issue handoff, requirement attack, escape closure and learning tests passed 10/10
